### [`ride-rank.ts`](../../lib/rankings/ride-rank.ts)

- `getRideRank` _function_: The ride's place in its country's current ranking, or `null` below `RIDE_RANK_SHOWN`, when the ranking is not there yet (the seed timed out, or the API has no such route) or the ride is not ranked.
- `RIDE_RANK_SHOWN` _const_: Down to which place a ride page names its place in the country's ranking. „Platz 3 in Deutschland" tells a reader something about the ride; „Platz 47" tells them about the list.
- Types: `RideRank`

### [`segments.ts`](../../lib/rankings/segments.ts)

- `rankingPath` _function_: Locale-relative path to a country's ranking of one year; `@/i18n/navigation`'s `Link` adds the locale.
- `rankingHubPath` _function_: Locale-relative path to the rankings' hub, every country that has one.
- `RANKING_SEGMENTS` _const_: Locale → localized URL segment of the year rankings of rides by wait: a country's ranking under its country page, `/de/parks/europe/germany/laengste-wartezeiten/2026`, and the hub under the parks hub, `/de/parks/laengste-wartezeiten`.
- `RANKING_CANONICAL_SEGMENT` _const_: The canonical route-folder segment (English), what the app router matches.

### [`year.ts`](../../lib/rankings/year.ts)

- `currentRankingYear` _function_: The year the site links and quotes the ranking of: the running year from March on, the previous one before. Never before `FIRST_RANKING_YEAR`.
- `FIRST_RANKING_YEAR` _const_: The first year the measured history can rank. Most parks' history starts in the last days of 2025, so 2025 holds a handful of days and no ride reaches the ranking's floor.
